html:
Sapa tour is designed for travelers who want to visit both the most popular attractions in Sapa and the vibrant Bac Ha Market (open only on Sundays) within a 2 day schedule. You will stay in a comfortable hotel, enjoy authentic cultural experiences, and save significantly compared to night-train options all while receiving the warm, friendly service of our team.

Itinerary

Day 1: Hanoi – Sapa – Cat Cat Village

Meals Included: Lunch, Dinner

06:00 – 06:30

Meet at the bus station, board the sleeper bus, and depart for Sapa.

07:30 – 11:45

Travel along the highway toward Lao Cai with a comfort break.

11:45 – 13:00

Continue on the mountain road to Sapa Town, passing magnificent valleys and terraced rice fields.

13:00

Arrive in Sapa Town, where ethnic groups such as H’Mong, Dzao, and Tay wear their traditional colorful costumes.

  • Welcome drink

  • Itinerary briefing

  • Lunch with Vietnamese dishes

  • Hotel check-in

14:30

Walk to Cat Cat Village, home of the Black H’Mong ethnic minority. Explore daily life, traditional crafts, and trek down to the valley to visit the French-built hydraulic power station and the waterfall. Continue trekking uphill for beautiful late-afternoon scenery before returning to Sapa.

Trekking distance: 2.5 km – approx. 2 hours

17:00

Return to Sapa Town. Dinner and overnight at hotel.

Day 2: Sapa – Bac Ha Market – Lao Cai – Hanoi

Meals Included: Breakfast, Lunch

06:15 – 07:00

Breakfast at hotel, prepare luggage, and check out for Bac Ha.

07:00 – 13:00

Drive 2.5 hours to Bac Ha Town, home of the Flower H’Mong people.

Visit Bac Ha Market, the most vibrant weekly market in Northern Vietnam featuring dozens of ethnic groups trading handicrafts, livestock, food, and local products.

Enjoy lunch at a local restaurant.

After lunch, take a short walk to:

  • Hoang A Tuong Palace (built in 1914 in French–Vietnamese architectural style)

  • Pho Village of the Flower H’Mong People

Trekking distance: 3 km – approx. 2 hours

13:00

Depart Bac Ha and drive 1 hour 45 minutes to Lao Cai City (not returning to Sapa).

15:00

Board the shuttle bus back to Hanoi.

20:30 – 21:00

Arrive at Hanoi bus station. The trip ends.

Trip Includes

  • Modern air-conditioned sleeper bus Hanoi – Sapa – Hanoi (Tour guide not available on the bus)

  • Bus from Sapa – Bac Ha – Lao Cai

  • English-speaking local guide in Sapa and Bac Ha

  • Meals: 2 lunches, 1 dinner, 1 breakfast

  • All entrance tickets to indicated sites

  • Accommodation in Sapa (double/twin/triple sharing)

  • Insurance during bus travel

Trip Excludes

  • Beverages, travel insurance, VAT, personal expenses

  • Services not mentioned above

  • Sleeper bus cabin surcharge:

    • Single cabin: 12 USD/person (round trip)

    • Sharing cabin: 8 USD/person (round trip)

  • Dcar Limousine VIP seat: 25 USD/person (round trip)

  • Luxury Limousine 28-seat Nouble: 16 USD/person (round trip)

Children Policy

  • Under 5 years old (or under 1 meter): Free of charge

  • 5 – 8 years old: 75% of adult price, sharing bed with adult

  • 9 years old and above: Charged as adult

Surcharge Policy

  • A surcharge applies during national holidays

What to Bring

  • Warm clothing, scarf, hat, cap (Sapa is cold from September to March)

  • Fog is common from December to March

  • Trekking shoes, sunglasses, sunscreen, insect repellent

  • Cash in Vietnam Dong

  • Personal medicine (although pharmacies are available in Sapa)

Tour Price per Person

105 USD / person 3 star hotel

114 USD / person 4 star hotel

142 USD / person 5 star hotel
